raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing export controls on civilian firearms and ammunition. For China-based exporters and traders of civilian firearms, parts, and accessories, this signals a more permissive US licensing posture for legitimate sporting and hunting goods, but does not remove core obligations: correct HTS classification (9302/9303 series), ITAR/EAR jurisdictional determination, BIS restricted party and Entity List screening, and Section 301 tariff exposure on China-origin goods. Verify whether items remain on the US Munitions List or fall under EAR controls, and confirm end-use/end-user documentation before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪械出口规则，放宽对民用枪械及弹药的出口管制。对于中国民用枪械、零部件及配件出口商和贸易商而言，这意味着美国对合法体育和狩猎类商品的许可态度趋于宽松，但核心义务并未取消：正确的HTS归类（9302/9303系列）、ITAR/EAR管辖权判定、BIS受限方与实体清单筛查，以及中国原产商品面临的301关税风险。出货前须核实产品是否仍属美国军品清单或受EAR管制，并确认最终用途/最终用户文件。

checklist.desc: Determine whether the firearm, part, or accessory falls under USML (ITAR) or the EAR; document the classification rationale and retain it for audit.
Confirm the 10-digit HTS line (9302.00, 9303.20, 9303.30) and cross-check against Section 301 lists and any additional duty exposure for China-origin goods.

checklist.task: BIS restricted party & Entity List screening
checklist.desc: Screen the US importer, consignee, and end user against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN; retain screening records.
Obtain a signed end-use and non-re-export statement from the US buyer confirming civilian sporting/hunting use and no diversion.
Confirm whether the rescinded rule changes license requirements for the specific item; verify current EAR classification and any license exception eligibility before filing.
Verify US consumer product safety and marking requirements for civilian firearms accessories, including any ATF marking rules for imported items.
